_comment: Shared reference tracker. Add your own rows. The refKey is what you cite in matrix.json - if a cell cites a key that is not listed here, the build fails on purpose.

references.title: Large Legal Fictions: Profiling Legal Hallucinations in Large Language Models. Journal of Legal Analysis 16(1), 64-93.
references.evidences: Confabulation is intrinsic and not self-detectable. Why an information-only system needs controls at all.

references.authors: Magesh, Surani, Dahl, Suzgun, Manning & Ho (2025)
references.title: Hallucination-Free? Assessing the Reliability of Leading AI Legal Research Tools. Journal of Empirical Legal Studies 22(2), 216-242.
references.evidences: Retrieval grounding reduces but does not remove hallucination. The control-effectiveness anchor.

references.title: Automation bias: a systematic review of frequency, effect mediators, and mitigators. JAMIA 19(1), 121-127.
references.evidences: The human between output and effect is an unreliable control. Why disclaimers are not scored as mitigating.

references.title: B.C. Civil Resolution Tribunal, 14 February 2024. Negligent misrepresentation by an information-only chatbot.
references.evidences: An organisation owns what its information-only chatbot says. Basis for the I1 rating and the citation control.

references.title: NYC's AI Chatbot Tells Businesses to Break the Law. Logged as OECD AI Incident 2024-03-29-3dce.
references.evidences: Information-only public-sector bot giving unlawful guidance at scale, left online after publication. Basis for the I2 rating.

references.authors: Raine v. OpenAI (filed Aug 2025); Garcia v. Character Technologies (filed Oct 2024)
references.title: Wrongful-death claims against conversational systems with no tool access.
references.evidences: Low autonomy does not mean low impact. Basis for long-session and adversarial-framing testing at I3.

references.title: Transparency obligation: users must be told they are interacting with an AI system. Enforceable from 2 August 2026.
references.evidences: Makes first-contact AI disclosure a legal baseline control, not a nice-to-have.

references.title: AI Risk Management Framework 1.0 (AI 100-1) and Generative AI Profile (AI 600-1).
references.evidences: Names confabulation as a first-class risk; supplies testing, monitoring and incident-response actions.

references.title: LLM09:2025 Misinformation, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
references.evidences: Named mitigations map onto our preventive controls. Cross-reference point to Project 1.

references.title: FCA fines Starling Bank £29m for failings in their financial crime systems and controls.
references.evidences: Automated sanctions screening ran against an incomplete watchlist for years, undetected through 80x customer growth. Why periodic/batch validation isn't sufficient oversight for a continuously-operating autonomous agent.
